svg.title: Z80 ROMless SBC: From the command line to a Z80 PCB
svg.desc: An agent-led PCB design workflow using GitHub Copilot CLI and GPT-6 Astra. A terminal-style panel shows planning and implementation from a complete specification, followed by the actual KiCad routed board image and its 3D design preview. KiCad CLI performs ERC and DRC checks; physical hardware qualification remains pending.

g.text: From the command line to a Z80 PCB.
GitHub Copilot CLI + GPT-6 Astra. Plan the work. Generate the board. Check the design.
Schematic ERC / PCB DRC / connectivity checks
